scope: official cleaned V1 files for AIppocampus retrieval-only benchmark runs, the fixed-reader V1 answer/latency harness, LongMemEval-V2 context-mapping pilot metadata, and the V2 official-harness pilot decision
checksum_note: sha256 values are Hugging Face LFS content oids and should match the downloaded file hash; the resolved download URL ETag may differ.

v2_context_mapping_pilot.local_file_policy: ignored local download only; do not commit raw questions, trajectories, screenshots, or reports

local_files.role: public V2 benchmark questions for context-mapping pilot
public V2 task trajectories for context-mapping pilot

decision: diagnostic context candidate-pack pilot is feasible at domain/environment pool level
benchmark-grade context-gathering score is not supported without explicit question-to-haystack or evidence-state labels
source-evidence R@K/MRR is not supported without gold evidence refs
answer accuracy and LAFS require the official reader/evaluator harness and remain out of scope for this runner

v2_official_pilot_decision.artifact_policy: ignored local official checkout, data, and output directories; publish only sanitized aggregate decision/report notes

claim_boundary: fixed-reader answer harness is opt-in and scored by a local deterministic diagnostic judge, not the official LongMemEval evaluator
answer reports must keep retrieval, answer quality, latency, token use, and cost separate
V2 context mapping pilot is diagnostic-only
V2 official-harness pilot decision is not a score
no promoted answer generation score until a dated sanitized provider run exists
no LongMemEval-V2 answer accuracy or LAFS
no SOTA or external-baseline superiority claim
